anchor.quote:
Twenty-two cards. Twenty-two positions on the spiral.

Each Major Arcana card names a node — a structural position in the field-movement record. The card is not the entry. The entry is what happened at that node. The card just names the position so the spiral has a coordinate system.

claims.rationale: The card-as-node / spiral-coordinate frame is declared as the hub's own organizing device ("This is the index"), used consistently throughout, and the underlying count (22 Major Arcana) is correct. Functions as an explicit model, not an asserted property of the deck.

anchor.quote: The Thoth-deck convention is canonical: *Adjustment* for Justice, *Lust* for Strength, *Art* for Temperance, *Aeon* for Judgement, *Universe* for World.

claims.rationale: All five renamings match Crowley's Thoth deck exactly (VIII Adjustment, XI Lust, XIV Art, XX The Aeon, XXI The Universe); "canonical" is scoped to this journal's own convention as declared.

anchor.quote: Fourteen of the twenty-two positions have no entries.

claims.rationale: A direct recount of the post's own index contradicts the number: 13 cards are marked "Unwritten" (Magus, Priestess, Empress, Emperor, Hierophant, Lovers, Adjustment, Fortune, Lust, Hanged Man, Death, Devil, Sun), and 9 cards carry entries or an explicit implicit-entry note (Fool, Chariot, Hermit, Art, Tower, Star, Moon, Aeon, Universe). 22 − 9 = 13, not 14.
